exams.en: No university-wide AI-exam permission verified; obtain exam-specific instructions.

privacy_data.en: Do not put personal, private or confidential data in prompts; PGR researchers must never upload confidential, proprietary or personally identifiable data.

approved_tools.zh: Gemini为校方支持且师生可访问，但取得账号不等于考核许可。

research_publication.en: PGRs must maintain original research and disclose AI-generated or modified material; thesis-specific use details require further verification.

teaching_guidance.en: The Common Approach integrates GenAI literacy into undergraduate programmes, while modules retain discipline-specific decisions.

exams.en: Exam-specific primary instructions are not separately retrieved in this bundle; check module and exam instructions before any AI use.
